name: NIRIKSHA: AI-Powered TOF Drone System
description: NIRIKSHA improves object detection and spatial awareness for Time-of-Flight (TOF) drones.

highlights.label: Model training
highlights.text: The team trained and optimized YOLOv8 models in Google Colab. Combining their predictions in an ensemble reached 84% accuracy in testing.

highlights.label: Dashboard and demos
highlights.text: Flask handles routing and serves predictions through its API. A custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript dashboard displays the drone data. ngrok exposes the local server for temporary demos.

highlights.label: Team
highlights.text: HalfBaked Engineers built NIRIKSHA for Hack-o-NiT. The team included Sudipta Sarkar, Rupanjana Majhi, Krishenendu Roy, and Avirup Guha Biswas.

name: FileStacker
description: FileStacker is a full-stack web app for managing files. It stores uploads in Amazon S3 and provides access through short-lived presigned URLs.

highlights.label: Frontend
highlights.text: React 19 provides the file dashboard and sign-in screens. TypeScript 5.9 types components and API responses, Vite 7 handles builds, and Tailwind CSS 4 provides styling.

highlights.label: API and database
highlights.text: The Java 21 backend exposes a REST API with Spring Boot 3.3. Spring Data JPA persists file metadata, users, organizations, and application records in PostgreSQL. Apache Maven manages dependencies and packaging.

highlights.label: Authentication
highlights.text: Supabase Auth handles registration, sign-in, and session refresh.

name: Fabricanova: Reinventing Style with AI
description: Fabricanova is a full-stack AI fashion design platform that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), the Gemma 2B language model, and a custom GAN.

highlights.label: Design workspace
highlights.text: A Python Flask backend serves AI features to a responsive glassmorphism dashboard built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Users can preview and edit designs and save and organize their projects.

highlights.label: Image retrieval
highlights.text: FAISS searches the Transformersx/fashion-product-images-small dataset for relevant product images.

highlights.label: Sign-in and data access
highlights.text: The app uses Google OAuth for sign-in. Its README lists Row Level Security to restrict access to each user's own data, along with encryption and GDPR compliance.

highlights.label: Testing
highlights.text: The project uses manual test pages, API scripts, and integration tests.
